purpose: Enter a native input value with the exact public React input prop surface. The documented text composition has a visible associated label, optional description and explicit invalid/error association. Browser editing and IME remain native; Escape does not restore an earlier value.

decisions.scope: Sufficient source-bound React reference description; no certification of every consumer or native platform.
decisions.normalizedProtocol: SCXML events project source callbacks/native interactions. Send entries document the observed callback and are not additional DOM dispatches. The adapter supplies isCanceled after the source callback transaction. Controlled SET_VALUE/SET_CHECKED props remain authoritative.
decisions.visual: Native FIG observations and DTCG values remain visual truth. React styles may differ; no unverified pixel equivalence is assumed.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Input fills its caller layout with min-inline-size0 and semantic 32px minimum height. The native 320px sample width is not an intrinsic component token and remains in source evidence. Source font14/20px,10px inline/4px block padding, border/radius and distinct placeholder/focus/disabled/error styling are retained. Label/help/field are explicit caller parts. Rounded shape is caller className, not an invented Input prop.
